lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Mo4O16 (reduced formula Ba2MoO4) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mo centers in tetrahedral O coordination (four neighbors, 1.79–1.86 Å) and Ba centers with eight O neighbors; O environments include a five-coordinate site with two Ba and three Mo neighbors and a three-coordinate Mo-only site. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ba 8-vertex and Mo 4-vertex polyhedra, plus corner-sharing between Mo tetrahedra.
